Use case: identity-preserve. Create exactly ONE standalone animation frame for existing game pet 汐螺. One newly AI-drawn pose, not a sprite sheet.
Input image 1 is E identity/camera. Image 2 is W identity/camera. Image 3 is the mandatory primary hand-painted material/style reference only, do not draw UI. If image 4 is present it is previous frame, preserve its exact shell/body scale, ornament locations and camera.
Identity: same coral-apricot hermit crab, large pale celadon cloud-pattern spiral shell, warm gold fine trim, ivory silk, osmanthus flowers/bell, red knot, jade/gold joints. Exactly SIX walking legs, three on each anatomical side, and exactly TWO front pincers attached consistently; two eye stalks. No extra tail/weapon/limbs.
Fixed camera and body center; feet stay planted in the same spot, only crab joints flex, not locomotion. Attack only with the SAME near-side pincer throughout. Far pincer guards. Do not exchange pincers or show duplicated motion outlines. Keep all foot/pincer/ribbon tips wholly inside image with generous transparent margin, including at the extended strike. Full character, transparent square 1024x1024 canvas; fixed support anchor region [512,942]. Bright clean rounded high-detail Taoist chibi hand painting from the references. No ground, floor shadow, checkerboard, text, border or FX. Target GPT Image 2.5/max is host-managed.
W genuine three-quarter REAR facing upper-left, same camera as reference 2: shell back dominant, spiral tip lower-right, face hidden behind shell, only eye-stalk edge allowed. Near-side attack pincer emerges upper-left; never turn chest toward viewer.
Attack W frame 9/12, 30 ms. Current pose: Half retraction. Same near-side claw lowers along its connected elbow arc and folds inward halfway toward the original upper-left neutral guard. Elbow visibly bent, pincer sits adjacent to left shell edge at mid shell height, two jaws slightly relaxed. Preserve pincer size and attachment, no limb switching. Far pincer stays tucked. Rear shell and support feet fixed.
Reference4 is previous frame, preserve exact geometry, size, fixed rear camera and limb root connections. Change only the specified crab joints and small settling details. No global translation, scale change, limb-count changes or duplicate claw outlines.
